# cricketdata ![](reference/figures/cricketdata.png)

Functions for downloading data on international and other major cricket
matches from [ESPNCricinfo](https://www.espncricinfo.com) and
[Cricsheet](https://cricsheet.org). This package provides some functions
to download the data into tibbles ready for analysis.

Please respect the terms of use for each website:
[ESPNCricinfo](https://www.espncricinfo.com/ci/content/site/company/terms_use.html),
[Cricsheet](https://cricsheet.org/register/).

## Installation

You can install the **stable** version from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=cricketdata).

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("cricketdata")
```

You can install the **development** version
[Github](https://github.com/robjhyndman/cricketdata):

``` r

pak::pak("robjhyndman/cricketdata")
```

## License

This package is free and open source software, licensed under GPL-3.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cricsheet_codes`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/cricsheet_codes.md)
  : Codes used for competitions on Cricsheet
- [`fetch_cricinfo()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/fetch_cricinfo.md)
  : Fetch Data from Cricinfo
- [`fetch_cricsheet()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/fetch_cricsheet.md)
  : Fetch ball-by-ball, match and player data from Cricsheet and return
  a tibble.
- [`fetch_player_data()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/fetch_player_data.md)
  : Fetch Player Data
- [`fetch_player_meta()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/fetch_player_meta.md)
  : Fetch Player Meta Data
- [`find_player_id()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/find_player_id.md)
  : Find a player id from cricinfo.com
- [`player_meta`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/player_meta.md)
  : Meta data on players listed at ESPNCricinfo
- [`update_player_meta()`](http://pkg.robjhyndman.com/cricketdata/reference/update_player_meta.md)
  : Update player_meta
